title: Entitled Woman Meets Karma After Kicking Cop
description:
On May 4th, 2023, officers responded to a dispute. While on the call, the dispatcher could hear a woman yelling constantly at one of the hotel’s employees, which made it difficult for them to understand the situation. Upon arriving at the scene, the officers learned that the female in question was having trouble getting inside her room because of a malfunctioning key card. Additionally, the female was behaving very aggressively from the beginning. The woman wasn't ready to cooperate with the officers at all and proceeded to go upstairs toward her room. Suddenly, the female began breaking down and hitting herself. The female continued to act agitated. She wasn’t ready to cooperate even with the medics. The female showed no signs of stopping her erratic behaviour towards the cops. Despite being cuffed, she continued to show resistance. The female was very abusive towards the medics and the officers. She continued to behave erratically. Soon, the female kicked one of the officers. She was transported to the jail for further processing. Shortly after, the medics arrived for a check-up. She was soon transported to the hospital. She requested the officers to go to the bathroom and then locked it from the inside, which wasn’t a good sign. The female was charged with aggravated battery upon a peace officer.

About Us / Disclaimer: 

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
